evidence: Static TypeScript symbol reachability from browser main.tsx, including lazy route exports. This establishes code integration, not rendered behavior or API equivalence. Browser acceptance is separate.
mappingPolicy: Exact exported component names plus explicit reviewed aliases; helpers carried only on the package namespace remain reference-only unless mapped. Imports, barrel exports, tests, and metadata alone are not integration evidence.

classifications.route-integrated: A native adapter symbol is reached from the browser entry through runtime references.
classifications.available-adapter: A native adapter is exported but has no runtime reference reachable from the browser entry.
classifications.reference-only: No reviewed native adapter symbol exists; the component remains available in the reference package.

components.intentionalDivergence: The native adapter exposes only options its callers use; reference ISO-decimal and Dr/Cr modes are not implied by shared naming.
The native adapter caps rich rows at 100 with Show all and uses explicit virtualization; the reference's automatic virtualization is not a product requirement.
WorkspaceNav and DesignSystemNavRail implement the browser's seven-workspace navigation over the reference visual contract.
Native notifications expose current workflow callbacks; reference-only Undo capability is not automatically integrated.

The shell renders DesignSystemMasthead directly; WorkstationTopbar is a compatibility wrapper.
